learning_outcomes.text: Acquire and understand the principles of the Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, and the operation and associated problems of typical mechanisms.

syllabus_topics: Degrees of freedom of a mechanism
Relative motion between two points. Polygons of velocities and accelerations
assessment_rules: For the continuous assessment modality, the final grade (CF) is calculated as 0.6 * EF + 0.1 * CCIN + 0.1 * CDIN + 0.2 * MP. A minimum score of 4 out of 10 in the final exam (EF) is required for other activities to be included; otherwise, CF = EF. The kinematics and dynamics questionnaires and the lab practical report are not recoverable in the extraordinary call, but the lab practical report score from the ordinary call is retained. For the global assessment modality, the final grade (CF) is 0.8 * EF + 0.2 * ELAB. A minimum score of 4 out of 10 in the final exam (EF) is also required; otherwise, CF = EF. Both the final exam and the lab practical exam are recoverable in the global assessment modality.
